block.field: Step Index AI hedge armed — Step Index 100, five ticks. The model's side is bought at full size and the opposite side at "ai hedge ratio" of it, so the pair keeps most of a measured edge while it caps the swing. Entries need the edge, agreement, confidence and a two-leg risk check.

AI is ready but the entry gate held it — the confidence floor, the losing-streak cool-off, or the pair's combined exposure against the balance percentage, loss limit and profit target blocked this cycle.
AI session stop — the loss limit, the profit target or the balance rule was reached. Open contracts still settle; restart the bot to begin a new session.
